Retirement/departure ascertainment status of the active URPS artifact

Source: R/urps_flows.R
urps_retirement_status.Rd

mufflyaccess exposes retirement only when the artifact actually observes it. Reads an explicit retirement_ascertainment manifest field when present (forward-compatible); otherwise contract 3.x historical stock is a survivorship-biased certification build-up with retirement not ascertained (see the artifact manifest known_limitations). "modeled" is deliberately NOT a valid value here: modeled retirement belongs in cliff, never in mufflyaccess.

Usage

urps_retirement_status()

Value

One of "observed", "partially_observed", "not_ascertained".

See also

urps_require_retirement_ascertained(), urps_counts_long()

Other URPS workforce: compare_urps_artifacts(), urps_count(), urps_counts(), urps_counts_long(), urps_entrants(), urps_entry_counts(), urps_lineage(), urps_provenance(), urps_require_retirement_ascertained(), urps_retired_values(), use_urps_artifact(), validate_urps_artifact(), validate_urps_ssot()

Examples

# Ascertainment status of the served artifact (the bootstrap does not
# observe retirement, so this is "not_ascertained"):
urps_retirement_status()
#> [1] "not_ascertained"
